notes: Judgment call on I3. Every uptake value (0.87 wt% max; Fig. 5 bar values 0.12-0.87 wt% for s_MWNTs and 0.27-0.79 wt% for l_MWNTs, cycles 1 and 2) is given at 3 MPa and 'room temperature' only. Schema v2 (data dictionary, temperature_unstated) says a condition stated only in words ('room temperature') is not a number and is not imputed, and only 'liquid nitrogen' has a registered numeric convention (77.3 K). Rows would therefore carry temperature_unstated = true, so I3 is coded not met and the code is no_conditions_stated. If the adjudicator reads 'room temperature' in words as a stated temperature, I1-I5 are all met (I4: BET areas 128/136 and 50.4/47.3 m2/g measured by N2 at 77 K on the paper's own samples) and no other code applies, so the paper would be eligible. Other checks: record.json is_retracted false and no retraction notice in the text; primary research article; no statement that the H2 values were published earlier; the neutron-diffraction work used D2 with no uptake amount.
